The M+1 peak of ~14% suggests the presence of carbon atoms (each carbon contributes ~1.1% to M+1). This suggests approximately 13 carbons (13 × 1.1% ≈ 14.3%).

The molecular weight of 182 with likely 13 carbons suggests a formula around C13H10O or similar.

Given:

- Carbonyl group (from IR at 1697 cm⁻¹)

This strongly suggests benzophenone: C6H5-CO-C6H5
- Formula: C13H10O
